weeks.title: Revision & Reflection
weeks.overview:
There is no new Personal Branding & Social Media lesson this week. Module 1 is complete, and Module 2 begins next week.

Rather than move straight on, this week is for revision and reflection. Go back over what you built in Module 1, make sure your Instagram profile genuinely reflects the direction you chose, and complete your Captain's Log for the week. Students who used this week to tidy up their profiles arrived at Module 2 with a foundation they could actually build on.
weeks.objectives:
By the end of this week you should have:

1. Reviewed the Personal Branding work you completed in Module 1.
2. Confirmed your Instagram account, username, profile picture and bio are all in place and appropriate.
3. Confirmed your category, contact information and pathway are set correctly.
4. Reflected honestly on what you learned, what you found difficult, and what you would do differently.
5. Submitted your Captain's Log for the week.

There is no new lesson content this week. Module 2 begins next week.

lessons.title: This Week — Revision & Reflection
lessons.content:
Welcome back.

There is no new Personal Branding & Social Media lesson this week.

Last week you completed Module 1 and built the foundation of your personal brand. Module 2 begins next week.

This week is a pause, and it is a deliberate one.

WHY THIS WEEK LOOKS DIFFERENT

Personal Branding & Social Media is your compulsory course, and it runs across the full 90-day sprint. Module 1 asked you to make a series of real decisions — which account to use, what to call it, how to present yourself, and what your profile should say about where you are going.

Those decisions are worth revisiting before you build on top of them. A profile that was rushed in week 1 will limit everything you do in Module 2.

WHAT TO DO THIS WEEK

1. Go back over your Module 1 lessons.
2. Check that your Instagram profile is actually complete and correct.
3. Complete your Captain's Log for this week.

Use the next two lessons to guide you.

We will see you next week for Module 2.

lessons.title: Recap — What You Built in Module 1
lessons.content:
Before Module 2 begins, make sure each of these is genuinely done.

Go through the list and check your Instagram profile as you read:

1. Created or selected your personal-brand Instagram account.
2. Set an appropriate username.
3. Added an appropriate profile picture.
4. Completed your basic profile information.
5. Written an initial bio that reflects your direction.
6. Selected an appropriate category.
7. Added relevant contact information where necessary.
8. Set up your profile with your UCA pathway in mind.
9. Identified an additional platform you may use based on your pathway and goals.

If any of these are incomplete or were done in a hurry, fix them now.

Remember that Instagram is your primary personal-brand platform for UCA. Throughout the 90-day sprint, this profile is where your work, your progress and your audience will meet. It is worth getting right before you start producing content in Module 2.

lessons.title: Your Reflection Task
lessons.content:
This week's work is reflection, and your Captain's Log is where you record it.

The log opens on Friday. Take it seriously — it is not a formality. Reflecting on your own progress is part of how you improve, and it is how you unlock next week's content.

Work through these questions honestly:

1. How was this week's learning experience?
2. What did you learn?
3. Who helped you during this week?
4. Who did you help during this week?
5. What did you enjoy?
6. What did you struggle with?
7. What can UCA improve?
8. Is there anything else you want us to know?

Be specific where you can. "I struggled with my bio" is less useful to you, and to us, than saying what you struggled with and what you tried.

If something in Module 1 did not make sense, say so. That is exactly the kind of thing this week exists to catch.

lessons.title: Looking Ahead — Module 2 Next Week
lessons.content:
Module 2 begins next week, and it builds directly on the foundation you set up in Module 1.

That is why this week matters. Everything you do from here assumes that your profile exists, that it is set up properly, and that it reflects the direction you have chosen for your pathway.

SO, BEFORE NEXT WEEK:

- Your profile should be complete, not nearly complete.
- Your bio should say something real about where you are going.
- Your Captain's Log for this week should be submitted.

If you have done all three, you are ready.

Take this week seriously, even though there is no new lesson. Use the time to tidy up your work, and come back next week ready to build.

See you then.
